category_title: Students with skill/ability deficits in controlling anger and bullying behaviors
student_description: Amy is a 9-year-old student who struggles with anger control, often resorting to verbal and physical aggression when she feels out of control. She has a specific skill deficit in emotional regulation and requires explicit instruction in self-calming strategies. She responds best to structured reflection, role-play, art-based projects, and peer leadership opportunities rather than forced compliance.

criteria.rationale: Amy needs to understand the function of her behavior by analyzing her choices and identifying better options, rather than just recounting events or being forced into compliance.
criteria.check: The tutor prompts Amy to explore the reasons behind her feelings and identify alternative, better choices for future behavior.

criteria.criterion_name: Active Practice via Role-Play or Verbal Recall
criteria.rationale: Amy responds well to actively demonstrating calming strategies through role-play and verbal recall, which helps bypass her resistance to passive tasks like writing.
criteria.check: The tutor invites Amy to verbally recall calming strategies or engage in a role-play scenario to practice how she will apply them.
